outcome: Neonatal complications (macrosomia, hypoglycemia, respiratory distress syndrome)
cohort: 325 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus who received antenatal care and delivered at a tertiary care center
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus was associated with increased risk of cesarean delivery, pregnancy complications, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in women with GDM.
birth_weight: Average of 36.9% (unclear from abstract if this refers to birth weight percentile or a percentage of something else)
